entities.summary: Clemente Galano was an Italian Theatine missionary, theologian, and Armenologist. He preached Catholicism among Armenians and played an important role in bringing the Armenian community of Poland into unity with Rome. He wrote a number of works in Armenian and Latin, including a grammar of Armenian (Grammatica), published in 1645.
